exact_construct_observed: Fixed three-profile membership derived from 14 annual OCS and GPAD features.

methods_actually_used: K-Means clustering; frozen assignment reconciliation

proposed_claim: Profiles are sufficiently stable for cautious descriptive use.
exact_construct_observed: Assignment uncertainty across silhouette, GMM posterior evidence and resampling.
source_datasets: Frozen OCS–GPAD profiles and uncertainty diagnostics
relevant_cohort: 6,067 practices
methods_actually_used: Silhouette, GMM posterior, algorithm disagreement and temporal resampling
key_evidence_result: 1,966 practices (32.4%) carry an interpretive-caution flag.
robustness_evidence: Half-year reference ARIs were high, while cross-period and algorithm differences remained material.
missingness_coverage: Uncertainty is available for all 6,067 practices and no uncertain practice was removed.
uncertainty: Multiple complementary assignment diagnostics; not a single probability of truth.

prohibited_wording: The profiles are definitive, permanent or equally certain for every practice.
additional_data_needed: Longer longitudinal replication would test persistence beyond the study year.
source_lineage: Profile master uncertainty fields plus temporal closure diagnostics.
